how: The opening commits a first tile and invites others to work on the flag.
The revised starter role fits proposing the flag and beginning placement without requiring later joining to be part of that role.
The opening proposes a shared flag without establishing a design debate.
The extension proposal and later extension report show plans and action to enlarge the mark beside neighboring pictures.
Participants report parallel starts, one flag's disappearance, and further placing on the continuing flag.
The final report tells the thread where a participant is extending the flag.
Anchor coordinates locate proposed and ongoing flags without establishing a shared pixel template.
The bare contribution report answers the invitation without asking for anything back.
The one-line extension report states a contribution without asking for anything back.
The call receives a bare contribution report, supporting the answer form without proving that the call induced the placing.
A reported loss prompts a participant to favor concentrating on an already active flag, distinguishing continued building from relocation or repair.
The report of a flag seeming gone fits the minimal work-judged-absent range without establishing insufficient manpower or space.
The drawer recognizes the flag and explains their own interference, supplying attribution at an individual scale.
An individual drawing over the flag apologizes and promises to stop upon recognizing the other work.
The theme supports restraint where a drawer promises to stop, while extension reports alone cannot establish sparing neighboring pixels.
Choosing open space and reporting early flag sites instantiate site selection before the recorded loss, without establishing collective relocation.
One participant judges overlap acceptable but complete blockage rude, supporting a fairness assessment without establishing reciprocal debate or a settlement.
An early report records one flag's apparent disappearance during continuing construction without establishing final survival.
Reports and a concentration proposal are compatible with informal coordination but cannot exclude organizational decisions in missing or external discussion.
Reports of adding and extending do not establish whether scripts or spare accounts also supplied placements.
Concentration and stopping overlap do not establish repair, defense, or keepers undoing a planned change because they lack updated information.
The unilateral complaint establishes a border judgment without a recorded negotiating exchange or settlement with its builders.
Adding to an already active flag after another disappears establishes concentration without demonstrating deliberation over fighting or relocation to a fresh site.
Proximity to another flag and comments about neighboring pictures do not establish requested, traded, or delivered help between rooms.
Neighboring flags and drawings do not establish coalition membership, shared organizing venues, or a jointly organized mark.
A drawer stopping their own overlapping work does not establish a host's rule governing another room's construction.
The drawer speaks for their own placing without a recorded mandate to represent another room.
Neither the individual promise nor the border judgment states or disputes anyone's standing to commit other placers.
Naming neighboring builders and judging their border does not establish an earlier quarrel carried into the canvas.
The flag proposal and neighboring-work comments do not establish ideological argument, a carried-in quarrel, or faith in a canvas colour.
Judging a blocking border identifies neighboring work without establishing an attack target or an earlier tie explaining an attack.
The practical invitation and reports of building do not establish a separate April Fools framing of the host subreddit.
Canvas contribution reports do not establish whether moderators or members regulated canvas discussion elsewhere.
Brief contribution reports show work underway without establishing completion, celebration, or collective credit.
The latest coded extension report does not establish a decision about carrying the temporary effort beyond the event.
The latest coded report concerns construction before closure, leaving correction of accounts or disputes over a retained canvas outside the coded evidence.
An objection to a blocking border does not establish an attack by the room or a call to attack the neighbor.
Calling a border rude does not establish a continuing rivalry, taunts, victory claims, or a contest carried between rooms.
Thread-side reports of building and concentration do not identify a planning venue or establish whether decisions also occurred in chat.
The drawer's self-recognition does not establish a question answered by another participant or an explanation of canvas mechanics.
The drawer's apology does not establish finding the subreddit through its mark, joining it, or being welcomed into its usual activity.
The border complaint does not establish a joke made from canvas work or a joke taken up by others.
Multiple flag starts within the existing room do not establish formation of a new canvas faction or its organizing venue.
Calling blockage rude does not establish argument about offensive language, a joke's acceptability, slurs, or hate symbols.
Describing an intended character drawing does not establish seeking notice from its creator, staff, press, or another outside audience.
Stopping overlap after recognizing another work does not establish quitting under stress or repairing a quarrel between members.
Public coordinate reports do not establish whether other plans were concealed or rival organizing venues infiltrated.
A lost flag and a border complaint do not identify members attacking their own work because they object to canvas posts.
Reports of adding and extending do not establish scheduling costs, device constraints, addiction, or competing everyday commitments.
Placing reports do not identify site faults, timer anomalies, access restrictions, or fixes to canvas controls.
The individual apology and neighboring-work judgment do not establish belonging to both rooms or divided loyalties at their border.
A report of a flag already going answers the call but cannot establish that the call recruited its maker to the canvas.
Starting and calling share one passage, leaving their distinct temporal order unestablished even under the revised starter definition.
Building, loss, and later expansion are visible without a supported transition into repairing or defending the placed work.
A top-level complaint about a blocking border does not establish that upkeep led to negotiation with the neighboring builders.
The drawer attributes stopping to recognizing the flag rather than to a recorded border settlement.
Reports of loss and concentration establish neither upkeep exceeding available placements nor a subsequent turn to automation.
Contribution reports establish ongoing building without a finished-work report linked to celebration or credit.
The early loss report occurs during construction without a recorded celebration causing documentation.
An early loss report and continued building do not establish documentation producing a decision about post-event continuation.
A missing flag fits the condition's minimal range but does not establish the arrow's insufficient-manpower judgment or resulting relocation.
Coordinates accompany proposed and ongoing action without a recorded design debate resolved by an agreed template.
Neighboring-work comments do not establish upkeep causing a shortage of hands followed by help from another room.
The border judgment establishes neither negotiation opening a channel nor subsequent exchange of help through it.
The build invitation and subsequent coordinate reports do not establish a call turning participants toward an attack.
The drawer explains an intended neighboring picture and promises to stop without identifying an attack call that prompted restraint.
The apology and border objection do not establish an attack call answered by a truce or negotiation.
The border complaint does not establish an attack creating a rival followed by taunts, chants, or victory claims.
Neighboring pictures and a blocking-border complaint establish neither shared defense nor upkeep leading to coalition membership.
The invitation establishes a call but no ensuing post flood or regulatory response caused by such a flood.
Neither an agreement followed by refusal nor a disclaimer during terms formation is recorded, leaving the bounded authority mechanism untestable.
